title: Raven Over Neon Eclipse
description: A dramatic surreal night scene depicts a large black raven with red wings flying through pouring rain toward a glowing circular portal. Below, a wet futuristic city highway stretches into the distance with illuminated roads, vehicles, and buildings under a stormy purple and magenta sky.
